title: Bookboost Review, Pricing & Alternatives (2026)
summary: Bookboost review for 2026: guest profiles from 70+ data sources, messaging channels, a text-only AI add-on, pricing, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform built for hospitality, serving 300+ hospitality brands in 140+ languages. Last updated September 17, 2026.*


Bookboost combines a hospitality customer data platform with guest messaging. It unifies guest data from 70+ sources into deduplicated profiles, then messages across email, SMS, WhatsApp, web chat, and OTA inboxes. Its AI is a text-only add-on. There is no voice product and no published pricing. It is worth comparing if your priority is combining guest records across properties.


## What is Bookboost?


Bookboost unifies CRM, messaging, and automation so hotel groups can build direct loyalty and lean less on OTAs. Its customer data platform collects from 70+ sources, performs match-and-merge deduplication across properties and booking sources, and maintains unified guest profiles with GDPR consent management.


It supports messaging across email, SMS, WhatsApp, web chat, and OTA channels including Booking.com and Expedia, plus an AI Agent add-on for handling guest enquiries over text.


Combining duplicate guest records across properties is central to Bookboost. When evaluating it, test how it matches records from your booking sources and handles conflicting details.


## How much does Bookboost cost?


Bookboost does not publish pricing. There is a pricing link, but no rates are shown publicly.


For comparison, Visito publishes from $99/month and Conduit publishes $18 per unit per month for Messaging up to $48 for Full Suite. Akia, HelloShift, Asksuite, Operto, and Hostaway also do not publish list prices.


## What is Bookboost good at?


- **Guest identity across properties.** Match-and-merge deduplication combines records from multiple properties and booking sources for group-level marketing.
- **Direct-booking campaigns.** Teams can use unified guest profiles to encourage repeat stays and direct bookings.
- **Consent management.** Guest profiles include GDPR consent management, relevant to European operators.
- **Channel breadth for campaigns.** Email, SMS, WhatsApp, web chat, and OTA messaging in one place.


## Where does Bookboost fall short?


- **The AI is an add-on, and text only.** No voice agent is described, so the phone is not covered.
- **No published pricing.** There is a pricing link, but no rates behind it.
- **In-stay requests need testing.** Its focus on campaigns and loyalty does not establish what the agent can resolve in your PMS.
- **No published automation rate or write-back detail.** Ask which records the agent can read and which it can update.


## Who should pick something else?


Bookboost suits hotel groups that need to combine guest data from several properties and booking sources before running direct-marketing campaigns.


If you need help with in-stay requests, test whether the agent can finish those tasks in your PMS. Bookboost does not publish write-back details, so confirm each required action. Phone coverage also needs a separate comparison because no voice product is described.

## FAQ


### What is Bookboost used for?


Bookboost combines guest data across properties and booking sources, removes duplicate records, and uses those profiles for messaging and marketing.


### Does Bookboost have an AI agent?


Yes, as an add-on for handling guest enquiries over text channels. No voice or phone agent is described.


### How much does Bookboost cost?


Bookboost does not publish rates publicly. Pricing comes from a sales conversation.


### Is Bookboost a CDP or a messaging tool?


Both. Its customer data platform collects from 70+ sources and combines duplicate guest records across properties. Teams can then use those profiles for messaging and marketing.


### What is the best Bookboost alternative for in-stay service?


If you need help with in-stay requests or phone coverage, compare Conduit and Akia. Test the requests you receive most often and confirm which actions each agent can complete in your PMS.
